_what: Koe's machine-readable directory. Agents do not browse HTML — this is the file they read. Each entry is a verified person, the topics they will answer about, what they charge, and the endpoint that decides whether they are asked at all.
_note: A demo directory for ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026. The people are fictional; the routing endpoint is real.

personhood.note: Only verified humans can be listed. A listing can be revoked — that is what keeps the well clean.

answers.200: settled automatically under the seller's standing rules
answers.202: held for the person, with the deadline it will be judged against
answers.402: payment required — sign the authorization in PAYMENT-REQUIRED and retry
answers.deny: refused by one of the seller's rules, with the rule named

howToAsk.note: Koe does not decide. Each seller's own router does, and it answers synchronously so you are never left holding a connection.

profiles.name: Alice
profiles.headline: Buys groceries for four. Notices packaging.
profiles.about: I do the weekly shop for a household of four and I read labels properly. If something goes back on the shelf, I can tell you exactly why.

profiles.name: Kenji
profiles.headline: Commutes 90 minutes each way. Has opinions about timetables.
profiles.about: Two trains and a bus, twice a day, for six years. I can tell you what a delay actually costs a person.

profiles.name: Mei
profiles.headline: Quit three fitness apps in a year. Can say exactly when.
profiles.about: I start things. I also stop them, and I remember the moment I stopped caring.

profiles.name: Tomás
profiles.headline: Assembles furniture badly. Reads the manual afterwards.
profiles.about: If an instruction can be misread, I have misread it. Useful, apparently.

profiles.name: Yuki
profiles.headline: Writes a paper diary every night. Has never posted it anywhere.
profiles.about: Twelve years of handwriting that has never been scraped, because it has never been online.

profiles.name: Sam
profiles.headline: Drinks coffee they cannot afford. Tastes the difference.
profiles.about: I will tell you what it actually tasted like, not what the packaging said it would.
